-- Module:WorldNext
-- Small "next ..." cards for the Main Page: the next world boss, the next daily event and the next game time event.
-- The page only carries the schedules, the script in MediaWiki:Common.js works out the next one in the reader's time zone.
-- {{#invoke:WorldNext|main|type=all}}  type = all (default: boss, daily, game), boss, daily, game or trader. Several: type=boss,game
local p = {}

local ev = require('Module:WorldEventData')
local boss = require('Module:WorldBossData')

local function esc(s)
	return mw.text.encode(tostring(s or ''), '<>&"\'%[%]{}|')
end

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

local function file(name, alt, size)
	return '[[File:' .. name .. '|' .. size .. 'px|link=|alt=' .. esc(alt) .. ']]'
end

local function anchor()
	local ok, a = pcall(require, 'Module:GameTimeData')
	if ok and type(a) == 'table' and a.utc and a.gt then return a end
	return nil
end

local function href(page)
	local t = page and mw.title.new(page)
	return t and t:localUrl() or nil
end

-- the hidden candidates the script picks the picture and the name from
local function bossCand(parent, id, b)
	local c = parent:tag('span'):addClass('wnx-c wnx-c-' .. b.cls):attr('data-id', id):attr('data-name', b.name)
	local box = c:tag('span'):addClass('wnx-ico')
	if b.ring then box:addClass('wnx-ring-' .. b.cls) end
	if #b.icons == 1 then
		box:tag('span'):addClass('wnx-pic'):wikitext(file(b.icons[1], b.name, 40))
	else
		box:tag('span'):addClass('wnx-pic wnx-pic-l'):wikitext(file(b.icons[1], b.name, 40))
		box:tag('span'):addClass('wnx-pic wnx-pic-r'):wikitext(file(b.icons[2], b.name, 40))
	end
end

local function eventCand(parent, id, e)
	local c = parent:tag('span'):addClass('wnx-c wnx-c-' .. e.cls):attr('data-id', id):attr('data-name', e.name)
	c:tag('span'):addClass('wnx-ico'):tag('span'):addClass('wnx-pic'):wikitext(file(e.icon, e.name, 40))
end

local function row(stack, kind, label, link)
	local r = stack:tag('div'):addClass('wnx wnx-' .. kind):attr('data-kind', kind):attr('data-label', label)
	if link then r:attr('data-href', link) end
	return r
end

function p.main(frame)
	local want = {}
	local t = trim(frame.args.type):lower()
	if t == '' or t == 'all' then t = 'boss,daily,game' end
	for k in t:gmatch('[a-z]+') do want[k] = true end

	local stack = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('wnx-stack')
	local anc = anchor()
	if anc then
		stack:attr('data-anchor-utc', anc.utc):attr('data-anchor-gt', anc.gt):attr('data-rate', anc.rate or 6)
	end

	if want.boss then
		local r = row(stack, 'boss', 'WORLD BOSS', href(boss.nextPage or ev.bossPage))
		local slots = {}
		for _, s in ipairs(boss.slots) do slots[#slots + 1] = s[1] .. '|' .. s[2] .. '|' .. s[3] end
		r:attr('data-slots', table.concat(slots, ';'))
		local cands = r:tag('span'):addClass('wnx-cands')
		for id, b in pairs(boss.bosses) do bossCand(cands, id, b) end
	end
	if want.daily then
		local r = row(stack, 'daily', 'DAILY EVENT', href(ev.listPage))
		local slots = {}
		for _, s in ipairs(ev.daily) do
			if ev.events[s[1]] and not ev.events[s[1]].panel then slots[#slots + 1] = s[1] .. '|' .. s[2] .. '|' .. s[3] end
		end
		r:attr('data-slots', table.concat(slots, ';'))
		local cands = r:tag('span'):addClass('wnx-cands')
		local seen = {}
		for _, s in ipairs(ev.daily) do
			if not seen[s[1]] and ev.events[s[1]] and not ev.events[s[1]].panel then
				seen[s[1]] = true
				eventCand(cands, s[1], ev.events[s[1]])
			end
		end
	end
	if want.trader then
		-- an event with its own card (panel = true): active now (time left) or the next spawn
		local ids = {}
		for id, e in pairs(ev.events) do
			if e.panel then ids[#ids + 1] = id end
		end
		table.sort(ids)
		for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
			local e = ev.events[id]
			local r = row(stack, 'trader', 'FREEDICH GOLD TRADER', href(ev.listPage))
			r:attr('data-short', 'GOLD TRADER'):attr('data-dur', e.duration or 0)
			local slots = {}
			for _, s in ipairs(ev.daily) do
				if s[1] == id then slots[#slots + 1] = s[1] .. '|' .. s[2] .. '|' .. s[3] end
			end
			r:attr('data-slots', table.concat(slots, ';'))
			eventCand(r:tag('span'):addClass('wnx-cands'), id, e)
		end
	end
	if want.game then
		local r = row(stack, 'game', 'GAME TIME EVENT', href(ev.listPage))
		local slots = {}
		for _, s in ipairs(ev.gametime) do slots[#slots + 1] = s[1] .. '|' .. s[2] end
		r:attr('data-gt', table.concat(slots, ';'))
		local cands = r:tag('span'):addClass('wnx-cands')
		local seen = {}
		for _, s in ipairs(ev.gametime) do
			if not seen[s[1]] and ev.events[s[1]] then
				seen[s[1]] = true
				eventCand(cands, s[1], ev.events[s[1]])
			end
		end
	end
	return tostring(stack)
end

return p
